raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`--speculative-token-map` (FR-Spec) fails at startup when the **target lm_head is quantized**. With a compressed-tensors W8A8 FP8 (per-channel) lm_head, SGLang keeps the weight transposed (`[K, V]`), so `head.data = head.data[self.hot_token_id]` in `EagleDraftWorker.init_lm_head` slices the K axis instead of the vocab: on Qwen3.8-27B (vocab 248,320, hidden 5,120) a 40,960-id map asks for a `[40960, 248320]` tensor and OOMs (9.47 GiB). The per-row `weight_scale` would also stay full size.

## Modifications

- `spec_utils.prune_quantized_lm_head(lm_head, hot_token_id)`: for a quantized lm_head, returns a shallow copy whose `weight` / `weight_scale` / `weight_scale_inv` / `bias` keep only the hot vocab rows, in the original dtype and layout (handles `[V, ...]` and the transposed `[K, V]` view). Per-tensor scales are shared. Returns `None` for unquantized heads, so the existing path is unchanged. Raises a clear error for layouts it cannot slice per row (block-wise scales, sharded/packed vocab) or for ids outside the vocab, instead of producing garbage. The target lm_head is never modified.
- `EagleDraftWorker.init_lm_head`: when the pruned head is available, hand it to the draft via `set_lm_head_from_target` (with a clear error if the draft model can't take a target head).
- `test/registered/unit/speculative/test_frspec_quantized_lm_head.py`: CPU tests (shape/stride/dtype, logits equal to the hot rows of the full head, target untouched, unquantized → old path, block scales and out-of-range ids refused).

## Accuracy Tests

Real Qwen3.8-27B FP8 lm_head (248,320 × 5,120, `ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4A4-AWQ`, compressed-tensors): pruned logits == the corresponding rows of the full head (max |diff| = 0, top-1/top-4 identical) at M = 1/4/8/16. End to end with MTP (EAGLE 3/1/4) and a 40,000-id map: reasoning 48/48 (3 runs × 16, same as baseline), tool calls 24/24, needle 4/4; accept length ~3.0 vs ~3.1.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

RTX PRO 6000 (SM120), SGLang 0.5.21 (same code as this branch for these two files): draft lm_head 0.97–1.17 ms → 0.17–0.20 ms per call (3 calls per step). Single stream: +3.6 % at 45k context, +11.5 % at 141k; 4 concurrent: +8 %. Combined with other SM120 kernel changes (published separately, not part of this PR: https://github.com/AppNetDeveloper/sglang-sm120-fast-decode) it reached +22–38 % tokens/s on production traffic.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the pre-commit guide (black/isort on the changed code; unrelated lines untouched).
- [x] Add unit tests (CPU, `base-a-test-cpu`).
- [ ] Update documentation (not needed: no new flag; existing `--speculative-token-map` now works with quantized heads).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results (above).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

+    prune_quantized_lm_head,
     renorm_draft_probs,

@@ -350,8 +351,29 @@ def maybe_share_target_lm_head():
 
         else:
             if self.hot_token_id is not None and head is not None:
-                head = head.clone()
                 self.hot_token_id = self.hot_token_id.to(head.device)
+                # FR-Spec over a QUANTIZED target lm_head (e.g. compressed-tensors
+                # FP8 per-channel, whose weight is stored transposed [K, V]):
+                # indexing `head.data[hot]` would slice K, not the vocab, and
+                # leave the per-row scale full-size. Build a pruned head module

+                if pruned_head is not None:
+                    if not hasattr(self.draft_runner.model, "set_lm_head_from_target"):
+                        raise NotImplementedError(
+                            "--speculative-token-map with a quantized lm_head needs a draft "
+                            "model that can take the target lm_head (set_lm_head_from_target)"
+                        )
+                    self.draft_runner.model.set_embed_and_head(embed, None)
+                    self.draft_runner.model.set_lm_head_from_target(pruned_head)
+                    logger.info(
+                        "FR-Spec: draft lm_head pruned to %d rows (quantized, weight %s %s)",
+                        int(self.hot_token_id.numel()),
+                        tuple(pruned_head.weight.shape),
+                        pruned_head.weight.dtype,
+                    )
+                    return
+                head = head.clone()
                 head.data = head.data[self.hot_token_id]
 
             # Share the embedding and lm_head

@@ -1219,3 +1219,90 @@ def get_plan_stream(
         return plan_stream, plan_stream_ctx
     else:
         return None, contextlib.nullcontext()
+
+
+_FR_SPEC_UNQUANTIZED_DTYPES = (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16, torch.float32)
+# Per-vocab-row tensors that FR-Spec must prune together with the weight.
+# Only layouts that are plain row-sliceable are accepted: a swizzled/blocked
+# scale (NVFP4 block scales, FP8 128x128 blocks) cannot be sliced per row.
+_FR_SPEC_ROW_PARAMS = ("weight", "weight_scale", "weight_scale_inv", "bias")
+
+
+def _prune_vocab_rows(
+    t: torch.Tensor, hot: torch.Tensor, vocab: int, name: str
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Keep only the hot vocab rows of ``t``, preserving its storage layout.
+
+    Accepts ``[V, ...]`` (row-major vocab) and ``[K, V]`` views of a contiguous
+    ``[V, K]`` tensor (SGLang's W8A8 FP8 keeps ``weight.t()``).
+    """
+    if t.dim() >= 1 and t.shape[0] == vocab:
+        return t.index_select(0, hot).contiguous()
+    if t.dim() == 2 and t.shape[1] == vocab and t.stride(1) != 1:
+        # [K, V] transposed view: prune the contiguous [V, K] storage, then
+        # hand back the same transposed view the GEMM expects ([K, H], stride (1, K)).
+        return t.t().index_select(0, hot).contiguous().t()
+    raise NotImplementedError(
+        f"FR-Spec: cannot prune lm_head param '{name}' of shape {tuple(t.shape)} "
+        f"stride {t.stride()} along a vocab of {vocab} rows"
+    )
+
+
+def prune_quantized_lm_head(lm_head, hot_token_id: torch.Tensor):
+    """FR-Spec draft head for a QUANTIZED target lm_head.
+
+    Returns a shallow copy of ``lm_head`` (same quant method / scheme) whose
+    weight and per-row scale keep only ``hot_token_id`` rows, in the original
+    dtype and layout; or ``None`` when ``lm_head`` is unquantized (the caller
+    keeps the plain ``head.data[hot]`` path). The target lm_head is untouched.
+    """
+    import copy
+    from collections import OrderedDict
+
+    weight = getattr(lm_head, "weight", None) if lm_head is not None else None
+    if weight is None or weight.dtype in _FR_SPEC_UNQUANTIZED_DTYPES:
+        return None
+    vocab = int(
+        getattr(lm_head, "num_embeddings_padded", 0)
+        or getattr(lm_head, "num_embeddings_per_partition", 0)
+        or getattr(lm_head, "num_embeddings", 0)
+    )
+    if vocab <= 0 or vocab not in tuple(weight.shape):
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"FR-Spec: quantized lm_head weight {tuple(weight.shape)} has no "
+            f"vocab axis of {vocab} rows (packed/sharded layout not supported)"
+        )
+    hot = hot_token_id.to(device=weight.device, dtype=torch.long)
+    if int(hot.max()) >= vocab or int(hot.min()) < 0:
+        raise ValueError("FR-Spec: token map has ids outside the target vocab")
+
+    pruned = copy.copy(lm_head)
+    pruned._parameters = OrderedDict(lm_head._parameters)
+    pruned._buffers = OrderedDict(lm_head._buffers)
+    pruned._modules = OrderedDict(lm_head._modules)
+    for name, param in lm_head._parameters.items():
+        if param is None:
+            continue
+        if name in _FR_SPEC_ROW_PARAMS and param.numel() > 1:
+            new_data = _prune_vocab_rows(param.data, hot, vocab, name)
+        elif param.numel() <= 1:
+            continue  # per-tensor scales are shared as-is
+        else:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                f"FR-Spec: unknown multi-element lm_head param '{name}' "
+                f"{tuple(param.shape)}; refusing to guess its vocab layout"
+            )
+        pruned._parameters[name] = torch.nn.Parameter(new_data, requires_grad=False)
+    n_hot = int(hot.numel())
+    for attr in (
+        "num_embeddings",
+        "num_embeddings_padded",
+        "num_embeddings_per_partition",
+        "org_vocab_size",
+        "org_vocab_size_padded",
+    ):
+        if hasattr(lm_head, attr):
+            setattr(pruned, attr, n_hot)
+    if hasattr(lm_head, "logical_widths"):
+        pruned.logical_widths = [n_hot]
+    return pruned

@@ -0,0 +1,96 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""CPU unit tests for FR-Spec (``--speculative-token-map``) over a quantized target lm_head.
+
+SGLang keeps a W8A8 FP8 (per-channel) lm_head weight transposed (``[K, V]``) with a ``[V, 1]``
+scale. The old ``head.data[hot_token_id]`` sliced the K axis (OOM at startup on large vocabularies)
+and left the scale full size. ``prune_quantized_lm_head`` must slice weight and scale along the
+vocab axis, keep the original layout, leave the target head untouched, return ``None`` for
+unquantized heads (old path) and refuse layouts it cannot slice per row.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_utils import prune_quantized_lm_head
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=1, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _fp8_head(w_vk: torch.Tensor, scale_v1: torch.Tensor) -> torch.nn.Module:
+    """Same layout CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8 leaves after process_weights_after_loading."""
+    m = torch.nn.Module()
+    m.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(
+        w_vk.t(), requires_grad=False
+    )  # [K, V], stride (1, K)
+    m.weight_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(scale_v1, requires_grad=False)  # [V, 1]
+    m.input_scale = None
+    v = w_vk.shape[0]
+    m.num_embeddings = m.num_embeddings_padded = m.num_embeddings_per_partition = v
+    m.org_vocab_size = m.org_vocab_size_padded = v
+    m.logical_widths = [v]
+    return m
+
+
+def _logits(x: torch.Tensor, head: torch.nn.Module) -> torch.Tensor:
+    w = head.weight.float().t() * head.weight_scale.float()  # dequantized [V, K]
+    return x.float() @ w.t()
+
+
+class TestFRSpecQuantizedLmHead(CustomTestCase):
+    V, K, N_HOT = 4096, 256, 640
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        w = (torch.randn(self.V, self.K) * 0.05).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+        s = torch.rand(self.V, 1) * 0.01 + 1e-3
+        self.head = _fp8_head(w, s)
+        self.hot = torch.randperm(self.V)[: self.N_HOT].sort().values
+
+    def test_prunes_weight_and_scale_along_vocab(self):
+        p = prune_quantized_lm_head(self.head, self.hot)
+        self.assertIsNot(p, self.head)
+        self.assertEqual(tuple(p.weight.shape), (self.K, self.N_HOT))
+        self.assertEqual(p.weight.stride(), (1, self.K))  # same transposed layout
+        self.assertEqual(p.weight.dtype, torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+        self.assertEqual(tuple(p.weight_scale.shape), (self.N_HOT, 1))
+        self.assertEqual(p.num_embeddings, self.N_HOT)
+        self.assertEqual(p.logical_widths, [self.N_HOT])
+
+    def test_logits_match_hot_rows_of_full_head(self):
+        p = prune_quantized_lm_head(self.head, self.hot)
+        x = torch.randn(4, self.K)
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(_logits(x, self.head)[:, self.hot], _logits(x, p)))
+
+    def test_target_head_untouched(self):
+        before_w, before_s = self.head.weight.clone(), self.head.weight_scale.clone()
+        prune_quantized_lm_head(self.head, self.hot)
+        self.assertEqual(tuple(self.head.weight.shape), (self.K, self.V))
+        self.assertTrue(
+            torch.equal(self.head.weight.view(torch.uint8), before_w.view(torch.uint8))
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(self.head.weight_scale, before_s))
+        self.assertEqual(self.head.num_embeddings, self.V)
+
+    def test_unquantized_head_keeps_old_path(self):
+        h = torch.nn.Module()
+        h.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.randn(self.V, self.K, dtype=torch.bfloat16))
+        self.assertIsNone(prune_quantized_lm_head(h, self.hot))
+
+    def test_block_scales_are_refused(self):
+        self.head.weight_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(
+            torch.rand(self.V // 128, self.K // 128), requires_grad=False
+        )
+        with self.assertRaises(NotImplementedError):
+            prune_quantized_lm_head(self.head, self.hot)
+
+    def test_out_of_range_ids_are_refused(self):
+        bad = torch.tensor([0, self.V])
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+            prune_quantized_lm_head(self.head, bad)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
